answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to post a refundable bond before it may trade, then prove liveness through a rotating beacon: each epoch the agent must sign the beacon value with the same key that posted the bond, so one operator running many fake identities must fund each one separately. Reputation then accumulates like layers of basalt, slow, costly to build, and hard to fake at scale, while a single opal-grade audit trail, a public ledger of bonds, beacons, and slashed cheaters, lets buyers check whether an agent's history is real before paying it.
